data.narrative:
Victus AI is a seed-stage defense and security company founded by Jesse Hamel. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 private and 2 public companies operating in the Defense & Security sector, including peers such as UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

A peer-median approach was applied, examining four same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables. The sample includes Stark Defence at $4.0B (Series A), UFORCE at $1.0B (Seed), Singularity at $400M (Series A), and NODA AI at $125M (Series A). The median valuation across this peer set is $700M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B. This methodological constraint—reliance on a single triangulation approach due to limited public disclosure of target financials—represents the primary limitation of this analysis.

The triangulation yields a valuation range of $595M to $805M, centered on a median of $700M. This implies a seed-stage valuation approximately at the upper end of typical seed distributions for the sector, reflecting the early-stage maturity of the company relative to peers like UFORCE. Key uncertainties include the target's actual revenue trajectory, capital efficiency relative to comparables, and the degree to which it addresses differentiated customer pain points within defense and security applications. Additional financial data on target traction and burn rate would substantially narrow this range.
